hero.title: AIX Roundtable Signals
hero.description: The conversations don't end at 16:30. Each roundtable produces a concise, anonymised strategic synthesis published in mid-January 2027 as an institutional reference document.

publicationMandate.title: Synthesising Closed-Door Executive Consensus
paragraphs: Mass conferences produce fleeting soundbites. AIX Summit is structured to produce durable intellectual output. Throughout the six closed-door 75-minute roundtables, dedicated rapporteurs capture the debate across six core analytical dimensions.

Crucially, points are recorded strictly without personal or institutional attribution under the Chatham House Rule. This methodological independence guarantees that the report reflects raw operational reality rather than polished public relations.

dimensions.title: Current Production Reality
dimensions.desc: Where enterprise AI is actively generating measurable business ROI today, versus experimental pilot claims.

dimensions.title: Capital & Infrastructure Allocation
dimensions.desc: Where sovereign funds, banks, and enterprises are directing hardware, cloud compute, and talent capital.

dimensions.title: Structural Hurdles & Risk Debt
dimensions.desc: Governance, agent identity, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and regulatory friction blocking autonomous scale.

dimensions.title: 12–24 Month Strategic Outlook
dimensions.desc: The architectural, operational, and organizational redesign required as copilots transition into autonomous agents.

dimensions.title: Three Practical Executive Actions
dimensions.desc: Concrete, immediate implementation priorities agreed upon across each table’s senior leadership cohort.

report.title: AIX Roundtable Signals 2026 Executive Report
report.description: Distributed to all attendees, partners, and accredited institutional delegates following editorial synthesis.
